decisions.reason: The firm is likely to keep the visibly launched multi-item men's care line because it has already invested in it, it still fits the natural-cosmetics positioning, and weaker results can be blamed on temporary market conditions rather than treated as definitive failure.

The firm is even more likely to keep the cleansing foam because it is a close extension of an existing facial-care series, so strategic fit and prior commitment make withdrawal less attractive unless performance is clearly poor.
